svg.title: Heatmap: investor time per slide type in DocSend and Papermark data
svg.desc: Two columns. DocSend seed guide, seconds per section: purpose 26, problem 34, solution 34, why now 23, market 29, product 59, competition 34, traction 40, business model 64, team 38, financials 37, ask 32. Papermark 2026, median seconds per page per view: cover 4.8, problem 3.2, solution 3.0, why now not measured, market 3.0, product 3.4, competition 3.2, traction 3.8, business model 3.6, team 5.7, financials 3.9, ask 4.2.
svg.text: Where investors spend time, slide by slide
Two datasets, two different metrics. Colour is relative within each column.
median seconds per page, per view
DocSend sections span 1–5 pages, so its numbers are totals per section.
Papermark counts one page in one view. Papermark appendix: 1.8 s (not shown).
Longest in each: business model (DocSend, 64 s) and team (Papermark, 5.7 s).
Sources: DocSend, What VCs really want to see inside your seed deck (updated
